comment: the-internet's Add/Remove Elements: the same button clicked twice on a page that changes each time (two identical actions that are not a repeat), then one of two identical Delete buttons. The pass is a count, which is soft for Jev, so the exact check is text_in on the container: its text equals 'Delete' only when exactly one button is left.
goal: Click 'Add Element' twice so that two 'Delete' buttons appear below it, then click one of the Delete buttons, so that exactly one Delete button remains.
notes: Each click on Add Element adds one Delete button under the horizontal line. Clicking a Delete button removes only that button.

checks.two_deletes: Exactly two 'Delete' buttons are shown below 'Add Element'
checks.one_delete: Exactly one 'Delete' button is shown below 'Add Element'

one_delete_left.when: Exactly one 'Delete' button is shown below the 'Add Element' button

add_did_nothing.when: No 'Delete' button appeared after 'Add Element' was clicked
